targets.rawSql:
WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${period}'
    WHEN 'mtd' THEN date_trunc('month', NOW())
    WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN '7d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN '30d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    WHEN 'shift' THEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours')
    ELSE date_trunc('month', NOW())
  END AS t_from,
  NOW() AS t_to
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 3600.0 * COALESCE(ldc.cost_per_hour, 0))
   FROM machine_stops ms
   JOIN asset a ON ms.asset_id = a.id
   LEFT JOIN line_downtime_costs ldc ON a.line = ldc.line_name
   WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
     AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
     AND ms.start_time BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
  ), 0)
  +
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.quantity_scrap * COALESCE(psc.cost_per_unit, 0))
   FROM production_orders po
   JOIN asset a ON po.asset_id = a.id
   LEFT JOIN part_scrap_costs psc ON po.part_number = psc.part_number
   WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
     AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
     AND po.started_at BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
     AND po.quantity_scrap > 0
  ), 0) AS total_loss

WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${period}'
    WHEN 'mtd' THEN date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month'
    WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 week'
    WHEN '7d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
    WHEN '30d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days'
    WHEN 'shift' THEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      NOW() - INTERVAL '16 hours')
    ELSE date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month'
  END AS t_from,
  CASE '${period}'
    WHEN 'mtd' THEN date_trunc('month', NOW())
    WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN '7d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN '30d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    WHEN 'shift' THEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT end_time FROM shifts WHERE end_time <= NOW() ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours')
    ELSE date_trunc('month', NOW())
  END AS t_to
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, (SELECT t_to FROM tr)) - ms.start_time)) / 3600.0 * COALESCE(ldc.cost_per_hour, 0))
   FROM machine_stops ms
   JOIN asset a ON ms.asset_id = a.id
   LEFT JOIN line_downtime_costs ldc ON a.line = ldc.line_name
   WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
     AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
     AND ms.start_time BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
  ), 0)
  +
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(po.quantity_scrap * COALESCE(psc.cost_per_unit, 0))
   FROM production_orders po
   JOIN asset a ON po.asset_id = a.id
   LEFT JOIN part_scrap_costs psc ON po.part_number = psc.part_number
   WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
     AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
     AND po.started_at BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
     AND po.quantity_scrap > 0
  ), 0) AS prev_loss

WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${period}'
    WHEN 'mtd' THEN date_trunc('month', NOW())
    WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN '7d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN '30d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    WHEN 'shift' THEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours')
    ELSE date_trunc('month', NOW())
  END AS t_from,
  NOW() AS t_to
)
SELECT
  a.line AS line_name,
  COALESCE(sr.name, 'Unspecified') AS reason,
  sr.category AS category,
  COUNT(*) AS stops,
  ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 60.0))::integer AS downtime_min,
  ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 3600.0 * COALESCE(ldc.cost_per_hour, 0)))::integer AS impact
FROM machine_stops ms
JOIN asset a ON ms.asset_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN stop_reasons sr ON ms.stop_reason_id = sr.id
LEFT JOIN line_downtime_costs ldc ON a.line = ldc.line_name
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
  AND ms.start_time BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
GROUP BY a.line, sr.name, sr.category
ORDER BY impact DESC

WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${period}'
    WHEN 'mtd' THEN date_trunc('month', NOW())
    WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN '7d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN '30d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    WHEN 'shift' THEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours')
    ELSE date_trunc('month', NOW())
  END AS t_from,
  NOW() AS t_to
)
SELECT
  a.line AS line_name,
  COALESCE(sr.name, 'Unspecified') AS reason,
  COALESCE(sr.category, 'Unknown') AS category,
  COUNT(*) AS occurrences,
  ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 60.0))::integer AS total_min,
  ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 3600.0 * COALESCE(ldc.cost_per_hour, 0)))::integer AS total_impact,
  ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 3600.0 * COALESCE(ldc.cost_per_hour, 0)) * 30.0 / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT t_from FROM tr))) / 86400.0, 1))::integer AS projected_monthly
FROM machine_stops ms
JOIN asset a ON ms.asset_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN stop_reasons sr ON ms.stop_reason_id = sr.id
LEFT JOIN line_downtime_costs ldc ON a.line = ldc.line_name
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
  AND ms.start_time BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
GROUP BY a.line, sr.name, sr.category
ORDER BY total_impact DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH weekly_downtime AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('week', ms.start_time)::date AS week_start,
    a.line AS line_name,
    COALESCE(sr.name, 'Unspecified') AS reason,
    ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 3600.0 * COALESCE(ldc.cost_per_hour, 0)))::integer AS downtime_cost
  FROM machine_stops ms
  JOIN asset a ON ms.asset_id = a.id
  LEFT JOIN stop_reasons sr ON ms.stop_reason_id = sr.id
  LEFT JOIN line_downtime_costs ldc ON a.line = ldc.line_name
  WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
    AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
    AND ms.start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '8 weeks'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('week', ms.start_time), a.line, sr.name
)
SELECT week_start, line_name, reason, downtime_cost, 0 AS scrap_cost
FROM weekly_downtime
ORDER BY week_start, line_name, reason

WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${period}'
    WHEN 'mtd' THEN date_trunc('month', NOW())
    WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN '7d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN '30d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    WHEN 'shift' THEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours')
    ELSE date_trunc('month', NOW())
  END AS t_from,
  NOW() AS t_to
),
good AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(po.quantity_completed * COALESCE(psc.cost_per_unit, 10)), 0) AS val
  FROM production_orders po
  JOIN asset a ON po.asset_id = a.id
  LEFT JOIN part_scrap_costs psc ON po.part_number = psc.part_number
  WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
    AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
    AND po.started_at BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
)
SELECT GREATEST(val, 1) AS production_value FROM good

WITH tr AS (
  SELECT CASE '${period}'
    WHEN 'mtd' THEN date_trunc('month', NOW())
    WHEN 'week' THEN date_trunc('week', NOW())
    WHEN '7d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN '30d' THEN NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    WHEN 'shift' THEN COALESCE(
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT start_time FROM shifts WHERE start_time <= NOW() ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1),
      NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours')
    ELSE date_trunc('month', NOW())
  END AS t_from,
  NOW() AS t_to
)
SELECT
  ms.start_time AS timestamp,
  a.line AS line_name,
  a.workcell AS machine,
  COALESCE(sr.name, 'Unspecified') AS reason,
  COALESCE(sr.category, 'Unknown') AS category,
  COALESCE(po.order_id, '-') AS batch,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 60.0, 1) AS duration_min,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ms.end_time, NOW()) - ms.start_time)) / 3600.0 * COALESCE(ldc.cost_per_hour, 0))::integer AS impact
FROM machine_stops ms
JOIN asset a ON ms.asset_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN stop_reasons sr ON ms.stop_reason_id = sr.id
LEFT JOIN line_downtime_costs ldc ON a.line = ldc.line_name
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT order_id FROM production_orders po2
  WHERE po2.asset_id IN (SELECT id FROM asset WHERE line = a.line AND enterprise = a.enterprise)
    AND po2.started_at <= ms.start_time
    AND (po2.completed_at IS NULL OR po2.completed_at >= ms.start_time)
  ORDER BY po2.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
) po ON true
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND ('${line:raw}' = 'All' OR a.line = '${line:raw}')
  AND ms.start_time BETWEEN (SELECT t_from FROM tr) AND (SELECT t_to FROM tr)
ORDER BY ms.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50
